Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane on the highway in Pearland, Texas, when Driver 2 moved from the center lane
into the same space without signaling. The front passenger side of Driver 2's vehicle struck the rear driver side of
Driver 1's vehicle, pushing it toward the shoulder. Both drivers pulled over safely. I spoke with Driver 1, Driver 2, and
Passenger, who was seated beside Driver 1 at the time. Driver 2 acknowledged changing lanes without checking the
mirror. Two independent witnesses in nearby vehicles described the same sequence, and each staetd they saw the
impact clearly. Scene photographs show scraping and deformation along the rear driver side panel of Driver 1's
vehicle, consistent with the direction and force of the contact. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness shrotly after
the collision, which is a common response to a sideswipe impact of this kind. Officers observed no prior damage to
either vehicle. Driver 1 is a member of the same housheold as the policyholder, and the policyholder's records list
Driver 1 as a regular driver. Passenger was also present and reported no injuries at the scene.
</page>

- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- occupants_listed: How many people does the police report list in the insured vehicle (Vehicle 1)? The rating is a whole number. Allowed: a whole number.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.
